name: delivery-time-germany
input: How long does standard delivery to Germany take and how much is it?
expected_output: Standard delivery to Germany takes 3-6 business days and costs 9.99 EUR; it is free for orders over 79 EUR.

name: ship-outside-europe
input: Do you ship to the United States?
expected_output: No. The shop only ships within Europe: all EU countries, the United Kingdom, Switzerland and Norway.

name: free-shipping
input: Is shipping free?
expected_output: Standard shipping is free for orders over 299 PLN in Poland and over 79 EUR elsewhere in the EU. Free shipping does not apply to express delivery.

name: lost-parcel
input: My parcel still hasn't arrived after two weeks, what can you do?
expected_output: If a parcel has not arrived within 10 business days of shipping, the shop opens an investigation with the carrier. If it is confirmed lost, they send a replacement or refund the order in full, including shipping costs.

name: return-swimwear
input: Can I return a swimsuit I bought?
expected_output: Yes, within 30 days, as long as it is unworn with tags attached and the hygiene liner has not been removed. Swimwear with a removed hygiene liner cannot be returned unless it is faulty.

name: refund-timing
input: How long does it take to get my money back after I send a return?
expected_output: Returned items are inspected within 3 business days of arrival. After approval, card and BLIK refunds usually appear within 3-5 business days; bank transfers can take up to 10 business days.

name: exchange-size
input: Can I exchange my jeans for a bigger size?
expected_output: There are no direct exchanges. Return the jeans for a refund and place a new order for the other size; if it is out of stock you can subscribe to a back-in-stock notification.

name: cash-on-delivery
input: Can I pay cash on delivery?
expected_output: No, cash on delivery is not accepted. Accepted methods include cards, BLIK, Przelewy24, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Klarna.

name: klarna
input: Do you offer buy now pay later?
expected_output: Yes, with Klarna, in Poland and Germany, for orders between 100 PLN and 5000 PLN.

name: failed-payment
input: My card payment failed during checkout. What happens to my order?
expected_output: The order stays reserved for 60 minutes so you can retry the payment from your account with the same or another method. After that it is cancelled automatically.

name: company-invoice
input: I need an invoice for my company, how do I get one?
expected_output: Enter the company name and VAT number at checkout. The invoice is attached to the shipping confirmation email; it cannot be changed to a company invoice after the order has shipped.

name: women-size-m
input: Which women's size should I order if my waist is 72 cm?
expected_output: Size M (EU 38), which fits a 70-74 cm waist.

name: sneaker-fit
input: Do your sneakers run true to size?
expected_output: No, the sneakers run half a size small, so ordering half a size up is recommended. Boots and sandals are true to size.

name: two-discount-codes
input: Can I use two discount codes on one order?
expected_output: No, only one discount code can be used per order. A gift card can be combined with a discount code.

name: newsletter-code-on-sale
input: Does the newsletter welcome discount work on sale items?
expected_output: No. The 10% welcome code is valid for 14 days, on the first order only, and on full-price items only.

name: winter-sale
input: When does your winter sale start?
expected_output: The winter sale starts on 26 December.

name: cancel-after-shipping
input: Is it possible to cancel an order that has already been shipped?
expected_output: No. Orders can be cancelled free of charge only until they leave the warehouse; after that you can return the order under the returns policy.

name: pl-parcel-locker
input: Ile kosztuje wysyłka do paczkomatu i jak długo trwa?
expected_output: Wysyłka do paczkomatu InPost kosztuje 11,99 zł i trwa 1-2 dni robocze; jest dostępna tylko w Polsce.

name: pl-return-window
input: Czy mogę zwrócić bluzę po 20 dniach od dostawy?
expected_output: Tak, zwrot jest możliwy w ciągu 30 dni od dostawy, jeśli produkt jest nienoszony, nieprany i ma metki.

name: de-gift-card
input: Wie lange ist ein Geschenkgutschein gültig?
expected_output: Geschenkgutscheine sind 12 Monate gültig und können für mehrere Bestellungen verwendet werden.

name: followup-norway
input: How long does it take?
expected_output: Delivery to Norway takes 5-8 business days, with standard delivery only. Import duties and VAT may be due on delivery.
